NAME

md_docs_2logging-audit-139 - Logging audit (#139)

Reviewed first-party logging across lib/, src/, public logging macros, and browser TypeScript sources. Searches covered severity, hot-loop calls, disabled logs, sensitive values, rate-limit units, and connection/authentication outcomes. Vendored libraries, generated WASM binaries, and intentionally verbose test and instrumentation output are outside the production call-site changes.

Area Findings and disposition Server/client packet and render paths Packet receipt, H.265 sends, frame hashes, buffer validation, and render timing were INFO or unsampled DEBUG. Sample repeated diagnostics; retain joins, leaves, stream changes, and failures. Correct string client IDs printed with integer formats. Audio Normal callback startup/read activity was WARN and worker statistics were INFO. Use DEBUG, sample recurring codec failures, and preserve device selection, fallback, and initialization outcomes. Media/session rendering Frame queue operations and FFmpeg sample diagnostics flooded INFO. Sample at DEBUG, bound drop warnings, and report failed ASCII conversion instead of silently skipping a frame. Correct recording-warning intervals from nanoseconds to microseconds. Crypto/authentication Decryption failure serialized the full symmetric key; OpenPGP parsing printed private bytes; private-key format detection printed file contents. Remove all three disclosures. Replace per-packet nonce formatting with sampled size/counter metadata. Preserve handshake, authentication, and rekey events without sampling. TCP/WebSocket/WebRTC/ACDS Preserve lifecycle and transport errors. Move service-loop, callback, signaling relay, and packet-dispatch traces to sampled DEBUG. Keep TCP connection success visible at INFO, matching WebSocket. Correct WebRTC diagnostic interval units. Discovery/database/NAT Keep session joins/leaves, host updates, NAT selection, and fallback events. Demote database join-policy implementation details and discovery initialization checkpoints. Options/platform/video/utilities Demote option parsing, DNS and POSIX keyboard setup checkpoints. Correct Linux/WASM webcam warning cadence. Keep validation errors, device failures, and platform fallback warnings. Existing utility errors and explicit debug/tooling output remain. Browser Move commit SHA, renderer allocation/resize, and sampled mirror-frame diagnostics to console.debug. Preserve browser warnings and errors.

Removed and missing diagnostics

  • Restore a bounded mixer sample-count diagnostic, fixing its string client-ID format. Restore known-hosts file-open tracing; keep SET_ERRNO_SYS for the failure so logging cannot overwrite its system error first.
  • Keep the disabled WebSocket service-thread exit log disabled: its comment documents an AddressSanitizer use-after-free during teardown. Restoring it requires a separate logger-lifetime fix.
  • Keep redundant memory/atomic-registration, aspect-ratio and palette-cache traces disabled. They add startup or frame noise without a missing outcome.
  • Reviewed removal commit 1abeab007: session setup failures still propagate SET_ERRNO to the owning caller. Do not restore the duplicate FATAL messages. Existing known-host persistence notices and terminal logging visibility remain.
  • Report a NULL ASCII conversion in the session pipeline at bounded ERROR level; the loop previously discarded the frame without a diagnostic at that boundary.

Verification

Build with the default Clang/Ninja preset, then:

cmake --build build --target ascii-chat test-crypto-logging
uv run --project tests/ascii_chat_tests --frozen python -m pytest tests/python/integration/crypto --crypto-logging-probe build/bin/test-crypto-logging

Use .exe on Windows. The standalone test uses the production crypto and logger, performs 1,000 encrypted round trips and 1,001 invalid-MAC attempts, checks bounded output and resumed reporting after the rate-limit interval, and rejects known key bytes or plaintext in the log. It does not require Criterion.

For browser source changes, run vp check in web/ and vp test --Config Module vitest.config.ts in web/web/. Running Vitest at the monorepo root incorrectly collects Playwright suites and omits the browser test setup.

This audit establishes severity and sampling rules, not a guarantee that every possible runtime failure has been exercised. Linux/macOS webcam and keyboard paths need their platform CI; generated WASM artifacts need rebuilding for a release. The first-party C logger's rate limit is per call site, not per client.

Version 0.14.7 ascii-chat
